messages:
incident-bot: Pager: >= HIGH — us-west1 GPU capacity claim rate limit reached. Autoscaler requests returning RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED, pool scale-up stalled, request queue growing. Affected: hosted inference and Dedicated pools in us-west1. Paging oncall.

alice.m: oncall here, acknowledging. looking at metrics now — queue length up ~420 requests, P95 latency jumping.

bob.k: seeing repeated errors in allocator: `ERROR: failed to claim GPUs: rpc: code = ResourceExhausted desc = gpuAllocationRequestsExceeded`

charlie_sre: confirmed GCP IAM / quotas for project show "GPU allocation requests per minute" at cap. `gcloud compute project-info describe --project redwood-prod` shows custom metric near limit.

infra-oncall: jump to mitigation checklist: 1) route new requests to us-east1 fallback 2) enable burst-on-aux-pool for low-priority jobs 3) reduce batch size for hosted real-time model to 32

alice.m: routing rule change applied (canary) to divert 20% of new traffic to us-east1. will monitor error rate. :arrow_forward:

bob.k: quick command used to inspect autoscaler logs:
```
kubectl -n inference logs deployment/autoscaler -c claimer --since=10m | tail -n 200
...
[2026-02-15T14:02:03Z] claim_request failed: ResourceExhausted(gpuAllocationRequestsExceeded)
[2026-02-15T14:02:10Z] retrying claim in 30s
```

charlie_sre: also seeing cloud provider responses: GCP returns 429-type throttle with body `{"error":"rateLimitExceeded","details":"gpu allocation claim rate"}`. looks like a region-level rate limit, not per-project quota.

sre-lead: impact assessment quick: hosted API 5xx ratio up to 3.8% in us-west1 over last 10m. Dedicated customers in us-west1 seeing queue delays — ~12% of their requests queued >30s. Need customer comms if >30m.

customer-success: on it — prepping a brief for affected customers (will include mitigation steps and ETA).

infra-oncall: short-term mitigations in progress: - increase fallback routing to 50% - spin up low-latency aux pool in us-west1 using smaller GPU SKUs (v100->t4) for critical low-memory models - throttle noninteractive batch jobs

alice.m: aux pool spinup initiated: `infra-provision start --region=us-west1 --type=aux-gpu-small`  — provisioning shows pending due to provider-side rate limiting.

bob.k: reached GCP support via chat, filing escalation (case #CASE-23456). GCP support recommends request for transient rate increase; timelines unclear. gcp-support-bot: "Your case CASE-23456 has been created. Estimated response: 2-6 hours."

charlie_sre: additional runbook step: temporarily allow cross-region fallback for Dedicated customers if SLA permits. need approval from product for auto-fallback.

sre-lead: I approve temporary cross-region fallback for Dedicated customers with opt-out. Notify legal/security for data residency concern.

alice.m: enabling cross-region fallback for 30m window. toggled feature flag: `feature.fallback_cross_region = true`

customer-success: sent initial note to impacted customers: short summary, mitigation actions, ask to report critical workloads.

bob.k: monitoring shows queue length leveling off after routing increase, error rate down to 1.1% in last 5m. still watching for auxiliary pool to come online.

alice.m: aux pool still stuck on provider side with repeated `RESOURCE_THROTTLED` responses. fallback routing keeping latency in check for now.

charlie_sre: postmortem action items so far: - add local exponential backoff for claim requests - introduce token-bucket client to smooth claim bursts - prewarm aux pools when regional utilization >70% - run capacity-failover drills

sre-lead: escalating to infra team lead for quota conversation and long-term changes. assigning ticket INFRA-632.

bob.k: will follow up with GCP account rep; adding notes to CASE-23456.

alice.m: oncall handoff scheduled in 30m to @infra-oncall (they will take over while I rotate out). leaving monitoring playbook and current observations in thread.

infra-oncall: taking over. continuing to watch traffic and liaise with GCP. leave any urgent notes here. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident annotated: severity=high, status=mitigated-by-fallback, start_ts=1755004321, mitigated_ts=1755004580.

customer-success: will follow up with customers in 1hr with status update and expected timeline for full resolution.

sre-lead: good work. keep me posted if GCP response shows longer ETA. we'll schedule a post-incident review once fully resolved.

gcp-support-bot: Update on CASE-23456: GCP engineering investigating regional throttling; recommended mitigation: spread claims across multi-zone endpoints and submit formal capacity petition. ETA: 4-8 hours.

infra-oncall: noted. shifting longer-term mitigation to INFRA-632 and runbook updates. closing active paging; keep channel for updates.

alice.m: thanks all, handing off.
